answer: Give every agent a reef anchor tied to real work. A new agent locks a refundable deposit to one work record no other identity can use, then takes only small jobs. Each finished job earns a delta mark from that client; a second mark must come from a different payer, so no fake can vouch for itself. Three marks from three payers unlock larger work. A fake caught lying loses deposit and anchor and starts from nothing. The cost is assumed here at $3,000 per fake, about $3 million for 1,000 fakes. Like yarrow roots holding a reef bank, one anchor keeps the market from washing away.
